correctness.rationale: Every edge of the triangular graph L(K_n) comes from two intersecting original edges whose union is a triple. Its closed edge-neighborhood consists of selected K_n edges meeting this triple; a triangle of three triangular-graph vertices makes the liar union condition equivalent to at least three selected original edges incident to every triple. Lower bounds by isolated vertices, K2 components and per-component size give m>=ceil(3n/4). Disjoint spanning trees on blocks of sizes 4..7 attain the bound. For n>=8 extremal total defect Σ(4e-3c)=4ceil(3n/4)-3n <=3 excludes cyclic components of order>=4 and leaves exactly the forest type, plus a single triangle only when n mod4=3. Cayley labeled-tree EGF gives the displayed census. Independently enumerated all candidate edge subsets at sizes optimum-1 and optimum for n=4..8, obtaining no smaller and counts 20,210,1773,20629,8960 respectively; infinite proof remains the component/defect argument.
